response.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT g.project_reference,
       g.funding_source,
       g.rate,
       g.rate - b.rate AS excess
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the simple average across groups with a defined rate; scans with missing size or duration, or zero duration (which makes the ratio undefined), do not contribute to a group rate.
